A little context

Learning today.
Building for
tomorrow.

I’m Swarnadip, a first-year B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering. I got into coding because I enjoy turning an idea into something I can build, test, and share.

Right now, I’m strengthening my foundations in C, Python, and web development. My next goal is to grow into full-stack projects and data structures, one concept at a time.

Outside coding, I enjoy gaming (and rebuilding the games I love) and figuring out how the things I use are made.
